Sustainable Livelihood Project Coordinator
Simberi Gold Company Limited’s operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Our vision is to grow sustainably and create enduring, positive impacts for the people and communities touched by our operations.
Now is an exciting time for our business and for our people. We’re going through a period of significant change and are gaining momentum in transforming our business. We’re looking for people who are ready to grow through opportunity and build a bright future with us.​​
We are currently seeking a
Sustainable Livelihood Project Coordinator
to join our Community Relations team for a permanent full-time position at our Simberi Operation. Your work location is Simberi Island, working a 21/14 Roster from Kavieng, Rabaul, Port Moresby, Lae, Mt Hagen, Madang, Goroka, Alotau, Wapenamanda, Popondetta, Hoskins, Wewak, Vanimo, or Tabar group of Islands.
(
Locals are encouraged to apply)
.
Reporting to the
Community Relations Manager
, the primary purpose of this role is supporting the Simberi Operations Community Relation technical function focusing on sustainable livelihood and other developmental programs and initiatives.
The key role accountabilities include managing, coordinating, and monitoring project activities and relationships with partners and other project stakeholders to assist the achievement of the Integrated Approach through the establishment of cooperatives in the Tabar Group of Islands. In addition, maintaining budgets for each task while also organizing shareholder meetings to bring together all stakeholders involved with a particular project.
The role will be responsible for ensuring scheduling, budgeting and details of a given task are well organized. It entails communication with various departments to keep everyone on board about any changes to the community sustainable projects. In addition, will involve organizing reporting, planning meetings, and providing updates to the Community Relations Manager and the management team.
The opportunity
Technical Accountabilities
Coordinate, monitor and report on community development and sustainable livelihood projects from initiation through to completion.
Lead project budgeting, monitoring, evaluation and reporting activities.
Develop and maintain project plans, documentation, schedules and progress reports.
Ensure projects are delivered in line with quality standards, compliance requirements and community expectations.
Support the development of strategic plans and long-term sustainable livelihood initiatives.
Identify capacity-building opportunities for staff, community groups and partner organisations.
Manage stakeholder engagement with cooperatives, government agencies and community representatives.
Promote and maintain high standards of safety, environmental stewardship and compliance across all project activities.
Recommend and implement improvements to project performance, productivity and outcomes.
Scheduling Accountabilities
Effectively manage project timelines, milestones and deliverables.
Coordinate resources and activities to meet project objectives and deadlines.
Maintain project management systems, controls and reporting frameworks.
Monitor project progress and proactively address schedule risks or delays.
Facilitate project meetings and provide regular updates to management and stakeholders.
People Accountabilities
Contribute positively to a high-performing and collaborative team culture.
Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Support knowledge sharing, teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.
Demonstrate leadership in safety, compliance and community engagement.
Take ownership of personal performance and ongoing professional development.
Are you ready to come and build your future with us?
We need the best people. People who have drive, energy and are genuinely passionate about the work they do and provide a positive impact. Additionally, we need people who see a challenge as an opportunity for growth and value working with others towards a common goal.​
We would love to hear from you if you have​:
Essential
Bachelor's Degree or higher qualification in Agriculture, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Project Management, Strategic Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years' experience in community development, project management or related fields.
Demonstrated experience managing projects from concept through to successful delivery.
Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Excellent organisational, planning and time-management abilities.
Experience in budget monitoring, risk management and quality assurance.
Strong client service and teamwork capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Microsoft Planner and project management tools.
Commitment to workplace safety and community development principles.
Desirable
Experience within the mining, resources or extractive industries.
Current PNG Driver's Licence.
Experience working with community cooperatives, government agencies or development partners.
Understanding of sustainable livelihood and rural economic development programs.

28151.description:
Develop and execute the SME banking strategy.
Lead client acquisition and deepen key SME relationships.
Build team capability and establish scalable operating processes.
The Role
Expatriate Opportunity
A growing SME banking business within an established bank in Papua New Guinea is looking for a Head of Business Banking to set the strategic direction and personally drive new business growth.
This isn’t a role for someone who wants to oversee from a distance — the SME team is expanding, and you’ll need to be hands-on, leading from the front on both strategy and business development. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll build the framework, grow the portfolio, and shape what SME banking looks like as the business scales.
Key Responsibilities
Set out and establish the strategic framework for the SME banking business
Develop and implement the SME banking strategy in line with the Bank’s broader objectives
Actively target and drive new business acquisition across the SME segment
Drive cross-selling of lending, trade, payments, and digital solutions across the portfolio
Lead product development and innovation tailored to SME clients
Oversee portfolio performance, profitability, and effective pipeline management
Build and maintain strong relationships with key SME clients, partners, and market stakeholders
Ensure sound credit decision-making, working closely with Credit Risk on approvals and portfolio quality
Collaborate closely with Credit, Operations, Treasury, Payments, and Trade teams to deliver an integrated SME proposition
Drive improvements in customer service, turnaround times, and resolution of escalated customer issues
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing SME banking team as the business scales
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, including KYC, AML/CFT, and lending guidelines, and support audit processes
Manage SME business budgets, cost-to-income performance, and reporting to executive management
About You
10+ years’ experience in banking, with strong exposure to SME/business banking and at least 5 years in senior leadership
A genuinely active, hands-on leadership style — comfortable building from scratch and generating new business personally
A proven track record in business development, portfolio growth, and team leadership
Experience scaling a team is highly regarded
Strong commercial acumen and credit/financial analysis capability
Excellent relationship management and negotiation skills
A relevant degree; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred
Why Apply
If you want genuine ownership of a growing business line — not just a seat at the table — this is a rare opportunity to build something real, with direct visibility to the CEO and executive team.
Apply

Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of heavy underground equipment in a safe and appropriate manner. This includes Trucks, Drills, Front-end loaders, Dozers, Mobile cranes (45T & 100T), and other pieces of equipment.
Key Accountabilities
Undertaking scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance of the company's heavy vehicle fleet, including Sandvik, CAT and Normet vehicles and equipment.
Respond to machinery breakdowns promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Servicing and preventative maintenance on Jumbos, Loaders and Trucks.
Diagnosis and troubleshooting of faults, and recommending servicing interventions that improve the operational efficiency of the company's heavy vehicle fleet
Rectifying machinery breakdowns in an underground environment promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Ensuring completion of all shift paperwork including service sheets, work orders and daily shift reports.
Completing all JSA's, risk assessments and documentation to ensure all work is completed safely and as per schedule.
Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to Trade Assistant’s and apprentice.
About You
Qualifications & Experience
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting with 3+ years’ experience in mining environment or heavy construction industry. In addition to this, you will have
Experience with Mining Equipment like Drills, LHD Loaders, Caterpillar Equipment, Sandvik Equipment etc.
Experience fitter with hydraulics training background.
Experience in the use of Pronto will be advantageous.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

28105.description:
Online Marketing Officer
Marketing - Port Moresby, NCD
Organisational Context
IBSUniversity (IBSU) is one of Papua New Guinea's leading private universities, dedicated to enriching lives through world-class education, training, and research. Established from the Institute of Business Studies (IBS), which began in 1989, the University has evolved into a recognised higher education institution committed to producing industry-ready graduates, advancing research, and contributing to national development. IBSUniversity officially attained university status in 2016 and continues to expand its academic offerings, research capacity, and international collaborations.
The University offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes through six academic schools:
-- School of Accounting and Finance (SOAF)
-- School of Business and Management (SOBM)
-- School of Economics and Development (SOED)
-- School of Information Technology (SOIT)
-- School of Education Major in Digital and Blended Learning (SoE)
-- School of PG Studies
These programmes are designed to meet the evolving workforce needs of Papua New Guinea while aligning with international academic standards. IBSUniversity also delivers internationally recognised programmes through long-standing collaborations with overseas universities, particularly with Southern Cross University, Australia.

28082.description:
Non-Executive Director (Board Member)
Shape the Future of Papua New Guinea's Largest Superannuation Fund
Nambawan Super Limited is Papua New Guinea's largest superannuation fund, entrusted with protecting and growing the retirement savings of hundreds of thousands of members. As the Fund continues to strengthen its governance, investment capability and member experience, an opportunity now exists for an outstanding leader to join the Board as a Non-Executive Director.
This appointment offers the opportunity to contribute to one of Papua New Guinea's most respected financial institutions, helping shape strategic decisions that will influence the long-term financial wellbeing of members and the future direction of the organisation.
The Opportunity
Reporting to the Board Chair, you will work alongside an experienced Board providing independent oversight, strategic guidance and sound governance across the organisation.
The Board is seeking an individual who can contribute fresh perspectives while supporting the Fund's strategic priorities, including:
Delivering strong long-term investment outcomes for members.
Supporting digital transformation and innovation.
Enhancing member experience and service delivery.
Strengthening governance, risk management and regulatory compliance.
Helping identify new investment opportunities within Papua New Guinea and beyond.
While previous Board experience is highly regarded, applications are also encouraged from accomplished senior executives seeking their first Non-Executive Director appointment.
About You
You are a respected Papua New Guinea business leader with demonstrated executive leadership experience and a reputation for sound judgement, integrity and commercial acumen.
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be highly regarded:
Corporate governance
Commercial or strategic leadership
Digital transformation or technology leadership
Superannuation, Investment management or funds management
Banking or financial services
Enterprise risk management
You will possess strong stakeholder engagement skills, the confidence to constructively challenge management where appropriate and a genuine commitment to acting in the best interests of members.
Female executives and candidates who will broaden the diversity of perspectives around the Board are strongly encouraged to apply.
Essential Requirements
Applicants should demonstrate:
Significant senior executive leadership experience.
Relevant tertiary qualifications (MBA or postgraduate qualifications highly regarded).
Ability to satisfy the Bank of Papua New Guinea's Fit & Proper requirements.
Residency in Papua New Guinea.
Capacity to commit the time required for Board and Committee responsibilities.
Eligibility to become a member of the Australian Institute of Company Directors (AICD) and PNG Institute of Directors.
Time Commitment
Directors are appointed for an initial three-year term and participate in approximately four Board meetings annually together with Board Committee meetings. The role requires appropriate preparation and attendance throughout the year and offers a meaningful opportunity to contribute to one of Papua New Guinea's leading institutions.
Confidential Applications
Global Talent Search has been exclusively retained by Nambawan Super Limited to manage this appointment.
For a confidential discussion, or to request the Position Profile, please contact:
Fraser Hawkins or Claire Venter
Directors at Global Talent Search

28064.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This role is responsible for the effective coordination of personnel engaged in electrical maintenance of the camp facilities, power generation and surface distribution network.  It ensures optimum equipment availability and reliability in relation to electrical maintenance by taking ownership of equipment and actioning any electrical repairs and maintenance requirements in a timely manner. This role will also involves overseeing some expansion projects and Subcontractors that have been engaged.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Coordinate workshop and site maintenance and refurbishment works.
Give direction, delegate tasks, and provide technical assistance to subordinates.
Effectively communicate on day-to-day maintenance issues with the Superintendent and Specialists with other Sections and work groups by providing updates of relevant issues and seeking information or input as required.
Liaise with relevant sections to provide input to various maintenance activities, e.g., assist the Maintenance Planning Section in the planning and development of day-to-day and weekly maintenance activities and work closely with procurement personnel.
Implement consistent compliance with set maintenance priorities by effectively planning personnel and material resources, effectively communicating day-to-day maintenance priorities with Supervisors, and monitoring and following up on consistency of maintenance standards and practices.
Train and direct the Technician Electrician, T/As and Apprentices to ensure they work as required to support the Planning and Scheduling activity and to ensure they correctly prepare work order work packages for the supervisors.
Compile Daily, Weekly, Monthly reports and reports on KPI’s and any report required by management.
Support Project activities within the Operational Services Group.
Create and maintain annual maintenance schedule and budgets include monthly and quarterly cost.
Develop Scopes of Work for subcontractors to tender against through our Contracts Team.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have Electrical Trade qualifications and/or higher certification in an Electrical Engineering discipline
Must be a NATTB Level 3 Electrical Mechanic Tradesman with PNG Power EW10 certification.
Maintain current electrician’s license to meet government regulations.
High Voltage Awareness and Switching Certificate
Good health and physical ability are a prerequisite, as is the ability to live in a remote environment with limited facilities.
Be flexible and adaptable and be a team player.
Good computer skills.
Good oral and written communication skills
The person shall have wide experience in the installation and maintenance of power distribution systems, transformer installations, motor control centres, LVHV transfers, and starters; and in the maintenance, fault finding and repair of equipment such as – washing machines, dryers, chillers, general light and power circuits.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

28050.description:
Senior Lecturer
School of Education (SoE) - Port Moresby, NCD
Organisational Context
IBSUniversity (IBSU) is one of Papua New Guinea's leading private universities, dedicated to enriching lives through world-class education, training, and research. Established from the Institute of Business Studies (IBS), which began in 1989, the University has evolved into a recognised higher education institution committed to producing industry-ready graduates, advancing research, and contributing to national development. IBSUniversity officially attained university status in 2016 and continues to expand its academic offerings, research capacity, and international collaborations.
The University offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes through six academic schools:
-- School of Accounting and Finance (SOAF)
-- School of Business and Management (SOBM)
-- School of Economics and Development (SOED)
-- School of Information Technology (SOIT)
-- School of Education Major in Digital and Blended Learning (SoE)
-- School of PG Studies
These programmes are designed to meet the evolving workforce needs of Papua New Guinea while aligning with international academic standards. IBSUniversity also delivers internationally recognised programmes through long-standing collaborations with overseas universities, particularly with Southern Cross University, Australia.
Role Description:
The Lecturer or Senior Lecturer is responsible for the design and delivery of curriculum, leading academic innovation, supervising research students, and ensuring academic quality through continuous improvement of teaching practices and learning materials. This role contributes to a culture of scholarly excellence and supports the professional development of junior faculty members.
This is a dynamic and highly respected academic position that influences both student success and institutional performance. The Lecturer or Senior Lecturer actively collaborates across schools and departments, contributing to interdisciplinary initiatives and digital transformation projects.
The Lecturer or Senior Lecturer reports to the Head of School (Education). This role demands a high level of autonomy, professional integrity, and proactive academic leadership
Key Responsibilities:
In a highly student-focused role, the Lecturer or Senior Lecturer should focus on strong collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills. It is also essential that you understand Global Management Best Practices and local industry trends. Lecturer or Senior Lecturer duties will involve managing and monitoring undergraduate/postgraduate programmes. This includes associated operational administration, curriculum development, course materials review and quality management and enhancement, ensuring a cohesive and effective educational experience. Senior Lecturer duties include but are not limited to the following:
Learning & Teaching
Deliver high-quality lectures, tutorials, and practical sessions at undergraduate/ postgraduate levels for both IBSU and SCU units.
Ensure the quality of tutor classes and complete the assigned syllabus within the scheduled time, in alignment with the Academic Calendar.
Tutor specific academic subjects to individuals or small groups using predetermined institutional resources.
Develop, review, and continuously enhance course content, teaching methodologies, and learning materials to support effective student-centered learning.
Utilize all available teaching aids and technology tools to enhance students' understanding and engagement with the subject matter.
Monitor student attendance, engagement, and academic progress consistently.
Ensure academic benchmarks for lectures are met as per the Key Performance Measures (KPMs) and strategic plan of the school by the end of each semester.
Lesson Preparation, Assessment & Examination Duties
Design, develop, and deliver face-to-face, online, blended, and flexible learning materials as assigned, ensuring they foster meaningful discussions and keep students actively engaged and motivated.
Ensure that unit/course design and delivery comply with quality standards and regulations of the University.
Assist in the conduct of examinations as per the instructions of the Examination Section, including the preparation of question banks and answer keys, marking of internal assessments, and duties related to supervision/ invigilation
Prepare and Submit Assessment check documents and DRMS promptly
Student Learning Experience
Provide a high-quality, inclusive, and engaging learning experience that supports students in achieving prescribed learning outcomes.
Supervise student projects, capstone work, and academic components of field trips, ensuring alignment with course objectives and safety protocols.
Offer academic mentoring and pastoral care, responding to student concerns with empathy and professionalism.
Support students’ participation in co-curricular and extracurricular activities that contribute to their personal and professional development.
Coordinate regular meetings and maintain effective communication with students to monitor academic progress and provide timely feedback.
Encourage independent learning and critical thinking through guided inquiry, project-based learning, and collaborative activities.
Facilitate opportunities for peer interaction and community-building within the learning environment.
Promote awareness of academic integrity, ethical conduct, and responsible digital citizenship among students.
Research, Scholarship & Innovation:
Conduct original and innovative research in areas relevant to Education/recent developments.
Publish findings in peer-reviewed, high-impact journals and present at recognized academic conferences.
Lead or collaborate on research projects, including applying for and securing external funding.
Engage in scholarly activities and innovation initiatives with the approval of the Head of School and the IBSU Research Centre.
Extend active support and contributions to IBSU’s internal research activities and initiatives.
Collaborate with researchers at institutional, national, and international levels to contribute to the School’s and University's research objectives.
Participate in subject-specific and professional development to enhance research-informed teaching.
Maintain active involvement and recognized contributions to relevant academic associations and professional bodies.
Student Supervision and Support
Supervise undergraduate/postgraduate research projects, ensuring academic rigor, timely progress, and ethical compliance.
Offer academic advising, mentoring, and career guidance to support students’ personal and professional development.
Foster an inclusive, engaging, and student-centered learning environment that respects diversity and encourages active participation.
Provide constructive feedback to support continuous improvement in student learning outcomes and academic performance.
Monitor student progress and intervene early in cases of academic difficulty, referring to appropriate support services when necessary.
Encourage student involvement in academic forums, conferences, internships, and co-curricular activities to enhance experiential learning.
Maintain accessibility and open communication with students through regular consultation hours and digital platforms.
Promote academic integrity and ethical conduct in all aspects of student engagement and assessment.
Curriculum Development
Design and deliver curriculum content that reflects current industry practices, academic standards, and emerging trends in the field of Education and Educational Technology.
Develop and produce high-quality learning materials that are relevant, inclusive, and accessible across diverse learning environments.
Take responsibility for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of modules, including appropriate assessment strategies aligned with learning outcomes.
Create course and unit materials that support active learning, critical thinking, and practical application for undergraduate programmes.
Align curriculum content with national qualifications frameworks, accreditation requirements, and institutional learning goals.
Integrate digital tools and innovative pedagogical approaches to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
Collaborate with colleagues and industry stakeholders to ensure curriculum relevance and employability of graduates.
Contribute to curriculum review cycles, including feedback analysis, data-driven enhancements, and curriculum mapping to graduate attributes.
Academic Leadership
Provide mentorship and academic guidance to junior faculty, tutors, and new staff members.
Lead or actively contribute to academic committees, working groups, and program coordination initiatives.
Contribute to policy development, curriculum planning, and the maintenance of high academic standards in line with institutional goals.
Promote a culture of academic excellence, integrity, and collaborative engagement within the school and across the university.
Industry and Community Engagement
Build/extend support in partnerships with industry and community stakeholders for curriculum relevance, internships, and research collaboration.
Represent the institution in professional networks, conferences, and community initiatives.
Adherence to Academic Calendar, IBSU Guidelines, Policies, and Procedures
Ensure timely completion of all academic responsibilities, including lesson delivery, assessment design, grading, and course coordination, in strict accordance with the university’s Academic Calendar.
Follow all IBSU policies, procedures, and quality assurance frameworks across teaching, research, and student engagement domains.
Submit grades, reports, and other academic documentation within institutional deadlines.
Participate constructively in academic reviews, internal audits, and continuous improvement initiatives as guided by the university.

K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.

28039.description:
Accounts Officer – Procurement, Inventory & Asset
The Organisation:
Pacific Adventist University (PAU) is owned and operated by the South Pacific Division of the Seventh-day Adventist Church. The institution is accredited by the Adventist Accreditation Association, an international denominational authority for all tertiary and graduate educational programs and institutions owned by the Seventh-day Adventist Church entities. The main campus is located on the pristine Koiari Park, 14 miles outside Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea. The institution was established in 1984. Since then, it has grown from a college of 20 students to a university of over 1000 students from across the Pacific.
The Role:
The Accounts Officer – Procurement, Inventory & Asset position is accountable for recording the cost of newly acquired fixed assets (both tangible and intangible), tracking existing fixed assets, recording depreciation, and accounting for the disposition of fixed assets.
Core Responsibilities:
Create and monitor a system of controls, procedures, and forms to record fixed assets.
Assign tag numbers to fixed assets.
Maintain and update the Fixed Asset Register with acquisitions, disposals, transfers, and depreciation.
Conduct periodic asset verification and reconciliation with physical counts.
Ensure compliance with internal policies, relevant accounting standards (e.g., IFRS/IAS) PAU and SPD policies.
Recommend to management whether fixed assets should be disposed of.
Record asset-related journal entries, acquisitions and dispositions in the accounting system.
Support month-end and year-end closing processes by providing accurate asset schedules.
Assist in preparing audit documentation and responding to auditor queries.
Reconcile the balance in the fixed asset subsidiary ledger to the summary-level account in the general ledger.
Calculate depreciation for all fixed assets.
Investigate the potential obsolescence of fixed assets.
Monitor depreciation calculations and ensure proper allocation to departments.
Ensure proper documentation of asset purchases.
Verify that procurement contracts and purchase orders align with asset capitalization policies.
Provide input on vendor selection and asset acquisition decisions to ensure cost effectiveness.
Track procurement-to-asset lifecycle to ensure timely registration and compliance.
Recommend to management any updates to accounting policies related to fixed assets.
Ensure adherence to PAU/SPD policies, statutory requirements, and internal controls.
Generate periodic reports on asset utilization, depreciation, and disposals for management review.
Identify opportunities for process improvement in asset and procurement management.
Other duties may be requested by the Team Leader – General Accounts & Resource Planning and Management/Finance Manager or the University Administration.
About you:
Qualifications and Skills required:
Active relationship with Jesus Christ, characterized by a deep desire for worship and service to God.
Diploma/bachelor’s in accounting, Finance or other similar areas. CPA qualification will be viewed favourably.
Minimum of three years’ experience in the relative area.
University Teaching Experience and a record of research in the respective teaching areas will be highly regarded.
Highly developed organizational management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects.
Significant accounting, finance and administrative experience to supervise the Business Office operations.
Proven ability to supervise and manage staff.
Strong ability to liaise effectively with all clients of the Business Office, including staff, students, parents and sponsors.
Proficient in Financial Management Systems or Accounting Software.
Must be detail oriented.

Click
https://www.pau.ac.pg/work-with-us/
to view ‘Position Description’ and ‘Application Form’. Submit a completed application form, including a cover letter setting out your relevant experience to the core responsibilities of the role, and copies of your educational qualifications in a

to

.

nd

Private Mail Bag, Boroko, National Capital District

28038.description:
IT Business Analyst
The Organisation:
Pacific Adventist University (PAU) is owned and operated by the South Pacific Division of the Seventh-day Adventist Church. The institution is accredited by the Adventist Accreditation Association, an international denominational authority for all tertiary and graduate educational programs and institutions owned by the Seventh-day Adventist Church entities. The main campus is located on the pristine Koiari Park, 14 miles outside Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea. The institution was established in 1984. Since then, it has grown from a college of 20 students to a university of over 1000 students from across the Pacific.
The Role:
The business analyst is primarily responsible for identifying areas where Pacific Adventist University can increase its efficiency and strengthen business processes. The business analyst will often work closely with others throughout the business hierarchy to communicate their findings and help implement changes. This role is responsible for understanding the business needs and align the applications and systems to meet the strategic goals of the Pacific Adventist University specified in the University’s strategic plan. The business analyst will do data analytics using surveys, reports and interviews to assess processes, determine requirements, and deliver data-driven recommendations and reports to executives and stakeholders but balance them against what’s technologically feasible and financially and functionally reasonable that lead to business improvements.
Core Responsibilities:
Creating a detailed business analysis using surveys, reports and interviews to outline problems, opportunities, and solutions for the business to achieve its goals.
Evaluating business processes/systems and identifying potential areas for improvements by doing qualitative and quantitative analysis using known methods.
Budgeting and forecasting for business savings.
Collaborating and monitoring application development with regular checks on requirements in collaboration with the project team.
Validating and documenting business requirements.
Collaborate with financial reporting and I.T teams to develop initiatives and strategies that optimize cost.
Defining business requirements and reporting them back to stakeholders.
Manage change of processes/systems and procedures and tracking results of the changes after implementation using user feedback.
About you:
Qualifications and Skills required:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology/Information System or Business, Management/accounting, Statistics or preferably MBA.
Minimum of 3 years’ experience in the role.
A history of leading and supporting successful projects.
Practicing Adventist Ethos.
Very good interpersonal and communication skills.
Oral and written communication skills.
Consultative skills.
Facilitation skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Being detail-oriented and capable of delivering a high level of accuracy.
Organizational skills.
Knowledge of business structure.
Cost-benefit analysis.
Processes modelling and mapping.
Understanding of networks, databases, and other related technology.

28025.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining the Power System team and reporting to the Senior Electrical Engineer - Power Generation, this role covers Kainantu Gold Mine’s Permanent Power Station, Temporary Power Station, Kumian Camps Power Generation, 800L Portal Power Distribution Systems and associated controls, you will be responsible for the Production, Transformation & distribution of Power across the HV Network. This role, under the direction of the Senior Electrical Engineer, will contribute to the design, implementation, and management of power generation and transmission projects for Kainantu Gold Mine.
The Electrical Engineer shall provide engineering leadership to the Generation & Distribution Network and will assist the business to achieve project objectives and deliver on its Asset Management Policy. Additionally, the role supports the Asset Management team to deliver the best outcome for the range of developing and existing energy generation assets.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure all statutory electrical inspections and works are carried out on plant site surface electrical equipment safely and within compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company standards.
Maintaining all electrical documentation and records. These include equipment specifications, data sheets, as build drawings, scope of works, change of management, and report writing.
Carry out engineering study, estimates, prepare technical drawings, P&IDs, E&I Schematics/SLDs, and specifications of electrical and control systems, procurement, and ensure installation conform to standards, project requirements, and safe operational requirements.
Communicates exceptionally within the team and in cross-functional work with other departmental sections and groups.
Assist with diagnosing electrical defects or hazards on systems, plant, and equipment, and identify adjustments, repair timely, and drive team to take key learnings.
Identify areas of sustainable improvement and drive to improve plant and equipment up time.
Assist with budgeting to meet plant and equipment operational requirements.
Perform reliability and maintenance of alarms, safety devices, and emergency electrical systems onsite.
Perform, enhance, and support the following functions as an Engineer:
Scoping, challenging and technical oversight/support for electrical design and site works associated with Power Generation under the Senior Electrical Engineer’s directions.
Maintain key relationships with Equipment Manufacturers, Service Providers and Industry Groups associated with Power Generation Equipment
Work within and support the Technical Authority Framework compliance as a Subject Management Expert
Review, justify and communicate recommendations for equipment selection, installation, operation and maintenance
Work collaboratively across relevant business areas in the development of commercial strategies and modes of operation to deliver design and performance improvements (for example, provision of ancillary services)
Reviewing and analysing SCADA data to assess the performance of operating power generating facilities.
Contribution to the development, review and ongoing support of asset management strategies and processes to ensure fleet equipment meets their intended design life at the lowest sustainable life-cycle costs
Under the guidance of the Senior Electrical Engineer, develop procedures and technical documentation regarding safe, reliable, and efficient operations and maintenance of power Generation equipment
Work closely with the asset digital team to develop performance analytics and monitoring strategies including predictive analytics
Develop professional relationships and effectively work with personnel across departments in an integrated organisation in performance of duties
Ensure health and safety, and environmental performance meets or exceeds company and regulatory requirements.
Ensure risk management plans are regularly reviewed and management actions are delivered; an
Address risk management as part of all material decisions taken.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Degree qualified or equivalent tertiary qualifications in Electrical engineering or related discipline.
Electrical engineering experience with low and high voltage equipment (min 5 yrs)
Safety focus for people and equipment
Critically analyse technical problems, formulate solutions.
Capability to provide whole of life thinking to an asset
Experience in Asset Management through Asset Management Procedures and Programs
Leadership for technical situations with the ability to take Initiative on key technical requirements or safety Implications
Power station or construction experience for large generation facilities is desired
5+ years relevant work experience in similar roles in power generation and distribution.
Knowledge in the maintenance of HV Equipment, electrical, electronic, and instrumental equipment commonly installed in Power Stations.
Experience with CMMS Pronto platforms is well regarded.
Computer proficiency in MS Office suite.
Sound planning, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Initiative-taking with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply
